extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Edible parts of plants — we eat different parts of different plants: roots (carrot, radish, beetroot, sweet potato), stems (potato, ginger, sugarcane), leaves (spinach, cabbage, lettuce), flowers (cauliflower, broccoli), fruits (tomato, brinjal, mango, banana), seeds (rice, wheat, dal, mustard). (2) Medicinal plants and plant products — neem (antiseptic, skin diseases), tulsi (cough, cold, immunity), aloe vera (burns, skin problems), peppermint (digestion), ginger (nausea, cold). Plant products: honey (from flower nectar), paper (from wood/bamboo), rubber (from rubber tree sap), oil (from mustard, coconut, sunflower), cloth (from cotton), medicine (from many plants). (3) Sun as energy source for plants — plants make food by PHOTOSYNTHESIS: they use sunlight + water + carbon dioxide → food (glucose) + oxygen. Sun is the ultimate energy source. Leaves have chlorophyll (green pigment) that captures sunlight. Plants give us oxygen to breathe. Misconceptions: 'potato is a root' (potato is an underground stem, not a root), 'tomato is a vegetable' (tomato is botanically a fruit — it has seeds), 'plants eat soil' (plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and CO2 — they absorb minerals from soil but don't eat it), 'neem is only a tree' (neem leaves, bark, and seeds all have medicinal value), 'honey is made by bees from flowers directly' (bees collect nectar from flowers and process it into honey in the hive). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PlantUsesGame), NOT export default. Export interface PlantUsesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
